translations.text: He was a most truthful singer, and he took great care to intercede for his people with the most merciful Creator of men.
"Have mercy on me, Ruler of powers, since you know the thoughts of men. Help, my Saviour, almighty God, the work of your own hands alone, according to your great mercy.
Wash me from sins, and my soul from stains, Creator of spirits. Cleanse the offences that I have ever committed in my life through the wicked thoughts of the body.

For I acknowledge all my wrongdoing, and every one of my sins is before my own eyes. The throng of my wicked deeds stands before me, and my guilt shines out. Forgive me, my Creator, source of the light of life, and grant me the joy of your love.
I have often sinned against you alone, and I have also done many evils, hostile-minded in my offences. I ask you for help, Lord of spirits, saving Christ,
for you have always taught sinners to turn and obey Christ, and so gain long life with you, just as you, Lord, Saviour of souls, overcame every kind of sin at the judgement.
Grant me, my Creator, that I myself may turn away from the sins that my forefathers committed before me and that I myself also practised afterwards.
Then, Ruler, gentle Lord, the broken bones that were for a while in humiliation will be in joy for ever.
Turn your face away now from my sins and from the misdeeds of my offences, Saviour of souls, almighty God, and through the mercy of your powers blot out all my wrongdoing.
Increase [?] a clean heart in me, Lord Christ, mighty God, and a steadfast mind to accept your will and to keep holy laws. And, Ruler of the heavens, firmly renew a right spirit within me.

Give me now joy, gentle Lord, the hope of your salvation, protector of all creatures. And strengthen me with your spirit, living shepherd of light, God himself, so that from now on I may always wholly conform to your will.

Free me in spirit, Father of mankind, from bloodshed and wicked hostilities, living God. Cleanse my offences, Saviour and helper, guardian of the kingdom of heaven. Then my tongue will rejoice faithfully in your own righteousness.

Now, living God, grant your helpful comfort according to the will of your good spirit, so that Mount Zion may be victorious and the walls of Zion, of Jerusalem, may be strengthened and made secure in joy.

Grant me, living Creator of mankind, mighty Lord, that the sorrowful wounds of my soul, the reckless sins I have committed in the flesh in old age or in youth, may be forgiven by your spirit through your love and slip away."
